title: Low-Bit N-Gram Embeddings for Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.31646v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Many recent open-weight language models use n-gram embedding tables to improve performance. These tables store learned representations of short token sequences, such as pairs or triples of consecutive tokens, which the model retrieves during processing. However, they can require substantial memory: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, for example, allocates 196 billion parameters to its Engram n-gram memory. We therefore investigate whether this memory cost can be reduced while preserving the performance improvement that the tables provide. We propose storing n-gram embeddings at low precision and systematically investigate different quantization methods and bit allocations across tables. Across nanochat-, Llama-, and GPT-2-family models trained from scratch, four-bit tables save approximately 75% of table memory while preserving more than 99% of the validation-loss improvement from adding the tables. translated_title: 面向语言模型的低比特N-gram嵌入
translated_abstract: 许多近期的开放权重语言模型使用n-gram嵌入表来提升性能。这些表存储了短token序列（例如连续两个或三个token的组合）的学习表示，模型在处理过程中会检索这些表示。然而，它们可能需要大量内存：例如，DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash为其Engram n-gram内存分配了1960亿个参数。因此，我们研究了能否在保留嵌入表带来的性能提升的同时降低这一内存成本。我们提出以低精度存储n-gram嵌入，并系统地研究了不同的量化方法以及各表之间的比特分配方案。在从零开始训练的nanochat、Llama和GPT-2系列模型上，四比特的嵌入表可节省约75%的表内存，同时保留了添加嵌入表所带来的超过99%的验证损失改善。使用更少的比特则会导致更大的性能下降。
tldr: 提出将n-gram嵌入表量化至四比特低精度存储，在从零训练的nanochat、Llama和GPT-2系列模型上节省约75%的表内存，同时保留超过99%的验证损失改善效果。
en_tdlr: Proposes storing n-gram embeddings at four-bit precision, which saves approximately 75% of table memory while preserving over 99% of the validation-loss improvement across nanochat-, Llama-, and GPT-2-family models trained from scratch.
